decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9am to 11pm Monday to Saturday and 9am to 10 on Sunday and Bank Hoidays.

Condition : 5 - Details of the mechanical workings of the fume extraction equipment shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the restaurant and retained thereafter.

Condition : 6 - Details of sound insulation between the ground floor and the first floor flat shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be implemented prior to the commencement of the restaurant and retained thereafter.
description: Change of use of retail premises (A1) to restaurant (A3) and installation of fume extraction ducting
